description: Na₃Sr₄Al₅F₂₆ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4₂/n space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.83 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.73 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.88 Å. There are two inequivalent Sr sites. In the first Sr site, Sr is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Sr-F bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.77 Å. In the second Sr site, Sr is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Sr-F bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.86 Å. There are three inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 28°. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.82-1.84 Å. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 27°. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.79-1.87 Å. In the third Al site, Al is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-28°. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.79-1.86 Å. There are thirteen inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sr, and one Al atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and two Al atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two Na, one Sr, and one Al atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Sr and one Al atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and two Al atoms. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sr, and one Al atom. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Sr and one Al atom. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sr, and one Al atom. In the ninth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Sr and one Al atom. In the tenth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Sr and one Al atom. In the eleventh F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Sr and one Al atom. In the twelfth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sr, and one Al atom. In the thirteenth F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Sr and one Al atom.
